Hello dear reader,

    I have used Dark Noise since 2021. A long term user to say the least, and a frequent one at that. I may not be an audiophile, of sorts, but I do love some good sounding stuff.
    That being said I do adore this app. It has proven to be useful… for the times I need to study in college. For the other times when I’m just seeking some noise refuge from the everyday hustle and bustle of life. This app allows you to create sounds that could bring back even the best parts of a troubled childhood. I never really had a problem. The sounds are limited but not enough to be noticeable, and when you grow tired you can make your own mix and your own style and be able to find something, of your accord and style, to match your needs. 
    
That being said, I would like to ask the creator to incorporate two new things into their app they made for us.
    
    - 1. I would love to see a sound creator page. Something to allow people to create their own sounds and be able to “post” them for their own and others enjoyment. Wether that’s as simple as making your own with the app’s given… or maybe add in a feature that could allow you to record and display your own sounds and mix and match accordingly. This could be the dark noise sound hub we all have been waiting and looking for. 

    - 2. I would love to see an update for spatial audio. Something that I can fully immerse myself in. I like to write, maybe not professionally but for myself and for fun. Sometimes I feel that I need to be “there” to be able to fully immerse myself where I’m at and so I can really get a feel for my surroundings. We often can imagine ourselves in the world we want to be in, so why not be able to do that? I feel as if this app could do that and become a lot more than maybe it was intended by giving us some more potential to do so. With the addition of more and more headphones and surround sound systems that are capable of handling 8D audio / Spatial sound in 2023 and beyond, I think it would be great to incorporate such things into an app designed for this. 

    Just imagine yourself writing for a new book about being a pirate. You put your ‘buds in and bam. You can hear the seagulls flying over head but in all directions. The waves crashing against the port of the ship. The sails bustling against the harsh winds. Your crew mates walking about, maybe drunk and stumbling some are, maybe softly speaking amongst themselves.                
    Just by that can you imagine how great this already quite amazing app could become? I would love to see it someday. In the meantime I find this app really to prove useful for everyday life, but I can’t help but to crave more.
ALSO APP IS SLOPPY DESIGNED. REGRET BUYING IT. THERE ARE OTHER BETTER OPTIONS IN THE STORE.
